name: nlyu-pm
description: Product discovery to PRD for product managers: research public evidence on your own repository or an example open-source product, choose an opportunity, build a clickable prototype, and write a PRD, with independent read-only reviews of both the evidence and the PRD. Between research passes, file new evidence in two minutes and get a weekly digest of what changed.

interface.shortDescription: Public evidence to a reviewed PRD, kept current each week
